description: This PHP source file defines the ModelsData class, which implements the ExtensionInterface for the Goteo framework. It provides methods for setting up extension arguments, exposing filter and function providers, and utility functions for retrieving pages and normalizing model data. The class also dynamically calls static methods on models based on input arguments.

classes.name: ModelsData
classes.description: Implements the ExtensionInterface to integrate model data functionalities into the Goteo framework, providing methods for page retrieval and model data normalization.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the extension with optional arguments.

methods.name: provideFilters
methods.description: Returns an empty array, indicating no filters are provided by this extension.

methods.name: provideFunctions
methods.description: Provides a map of function names to class methods for use in templates or other extension points.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Retrieves a Page model instance via its ID or identifier.

methods.name: model_static
methods.description: Dynamically calls a static method on a specified model class, either in the Goteo\Model namespace or the Goteo\Library namespace.

methods.name: model_list_entries
methods.description: Normalizes a list of models or objects into associative arrays for further processing, using specified keys.
